stories.headline: Musk announces Tesla Terafab AI chip factory launches in 7 days, targets 2nm process

key_facts.fact: Elon Musk posted on X on March 14 that Tesla's Terafab project to manufacture AI chips will launch in seven days (March 21, 2026).
key_facts.excerpt: On March 14, Elon Musk posted on X that the Terafab Project launches in seven days.

key_facts.fact: Tesla first confirmed Terafab on its January 28, 2026 earnings call, with estimated cost of approximately $25 billion as part of Tesla's record capex plan exceeding $20 billion for 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Tesla first confirmed Terafab on its January 28, 2026 earnings call. Musk told investors the company needs to build a chip fabrication facility to avoid a supply constraint it projects will materialise within three to four years.

key_facts.fact: Terafab targets 2nm process technology and aims to produce 100-200 billion custom AI and memory chips annually, with initial output of 100,000 wafer starts per month scaling toward one million.
key_facts.excerpt: Musk has repeatedly pitched the idea of creating his fab network, saying it would help Tesla fulfill its custom silicon ambitions and, at the same time, allow the US to reduce its reliance on TSMC.

key_facts.fact: The AI5 fifth-generation AI chip will be among the first products, powering Tesla's Full Self-Driving software, Cybercab robotaxi, Optimus humanoid robots, and xAI's Grok model training.
key_facts.excerpt: The facility combines logic processing, memory storage, and advanced packaging in vertically integrated manufacturing.

key_facts.fact: Tesla is designing the facility to combine memory, chips, and packaging production in one vertically integrated facility, with potential licensing agreements with Intel and TSMC under discussion.
key_facts.excerpt: Combining memory, chips, and packaging production in one facility.

stories.headline: Turkey's Baykar unveils K2 AI-powered kamikaze drone with 2,000 km range and swarm capability

key_facts.fact: Turkish drone manufacturer Baykar unveiled the K2 kamikaze UAV on March 14, featuring AI-based flight, navigation, targeting and engagement systems with a 2,000 km range and 200 kg warhead.
key_facts.excerpt: Baykar listed K2's specifications as a range of 2000 km, MTOW of 800 kg, and a 200 kg warhead.

key_facts.fact: During test flights over the Saros Gulf, five K2 units demonstrated autonomous swarm flights maintaining V-shape, line, wall, and Turan formations without direct human control.
key_facts.excerpt: The test demonstrated five K2 units operating together with autonomous swarm capabilities including coordinated landing that includes parking.

key_facts.fact: The K2 features AI vision-based navigation that operates in GPS-denied environments by using onboard cameras to visually scan terrain and estimate position autonomously.
key_facts.excerpt: The K2 is capable of autonomous swarm flight and uses AI vision for navigation, targeting and engagement.

key_facts.fact: The K2 has an 800 kg maximum takeoff weight, exceeds 200 km/h speed, over 13 hours endurance, and can take off from short unprepared runways, with a reusable design planned in future variants.
key_facts.excerpt: K2 can take off from unprepared short runways and be reused.

sources.title: Baykar Unveils K2 Long-Range Kamikaze UAV with Swarm Option
Baykar unveils new K2 kamikaze drone with AI, 2,000 km range

stories.headline: Toyota Canada to deploy Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid robots in manufacturing plants

key_facts.fact: Toyota Canada has signed an agreement for up to seven Agility Robotics Digit humanoid robots, starting with three units for deployment in manufacturing operations.
key_facts.excerpt: Toyota Canada has an agreement for up to seven robots total, with plans to start with three units.

key_facts.fact: Digit can carry up to 35 pounds, walk at 3.4 mph, operate for up to 8 hours per charge, and navigate using LiDAR, depth cameras, and RGB cameras including climbing stairs and ramps.
key_facts.excerpt: Digit will take on repetitive and laborious tasks that will help human employees prioritize more demanding tasks and avoid injuries.

key_facts.fact: The robots will handle repetitive and laborious tasks in manufacturing, supply chain, and logistics at Toyota's RAV4 plant in Woodstock, Ontario.
key_facts.excerpt: Digit will take on repetitive and laborious tasks that will help human employees prioritize more demanding tasks and avoid injuries.

sources.title: Your Next Toyota Model May Be Built With The Help Of A Robot Named Digit

stories.headline: US Senators probe Meta, OpenAI, xAI over colossal gas-powered AI data center plans

key_facts.fact: Senators Whitehouse, Heinrich, and Van Hollen sent investigation letters to eight AI companies including Meta, OpenAI, xAI, Crusoe, and Fermi America, with March 27 response deadlines, demanding information about planned gas-powered data center facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: Senator Sheldon Whitehouse, Ranking Member of the Senate Committee on Environment and Public Works, Senator Martin Heinrich, Ranking Member of the Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources, Senator Chris Van Hollen.

key_facts.fact: Pacifico Energy's proposed GW Ranch facility would have 7.65 GW capacity and is permitted for 12,000 tons of health-harming pollutants and over 30 million tons of greenhouse gases annually.
key_facts.excerpt: GW Ranch permit authorizes 12,000 tons of health-harming pollutants and 30+ million tons of greenhouse gases annually.

key_facts.fact: The senators warned that proposed gas plants are 10+ times larger than average US grid facilities, and if all current US gas-powered data center projects are completed they would emit 12.1 billion tons of CO2 over their lifetimes.
key_facts.excerpt: Combusting gas to generate electricity can have an equivalent carbon intensity to combusting coal without adequate mitigation measures.

sources.outlet: EIN Presswire / US Senate EPW Committee
sources.title: Whitehouse, Heinrich, and Van Hollen Probe AI Companies About Plans for Colossal Gas-Powered Data Centers

stories.headline: ACE Robotics open-sources Kairos 3.0-4B, a real-time world model 72x faster than Nvidia Cosmos

key_facts.fact: ACE Robotics released Kairos 3.0-4B on March 14, a 4-billion-parameter generative world model built from the ground up for embodied intelligence, open-sourced on GitHub and Hugging Face.
key_facts.excerpt: A native world model built from the ground up for embodied intelligence, Kairos 3.0-4B delivers exceptional physics-consistent deep understanding and cross-embodiment generalization.

key_facts.fact: Kairos 3.0-4B achieves 72x faster inference than Nvidia Cosmos 2.5 on A800 GPUs and runs in real-time on edge hardware (Nvidia Jetson Thor T5000) with a 1:1.5 generation-to-video ratio.
key_facts.excerpt: As a lightweight 4B-parameter model, Kairos 3.0-4B outperforms mainstream embodied world models while delivering industry-leading inference efficiency.

key_facts.fact: The model enables cross-embodiment generalization, allowing a single 'brain' to drive robots of multiple form factors including Unitree G1, Agilex PIPER, and Galaxy G1 platforms.
key_facts.excerpt: Enabling a single 'brain' to drive robots of multiple form factors.

key_facts.fact: Kairos 3.0-4B requires only 23.5 GB of VRAM and tops benchmarks on PAI-Bench-robot, WorldModelBench-robot TI2V, and Nvidia GEAR Lab's DreamGen Bench.
key_facts.excerpt: Top rankings on PAI-Bench-robot, WorldModelBench-robot TI2V, and NVIDIA GEAR Lab's DreamGen Bench.

sources.title: ACE ROBOTICS Open-Sources Real-Time Generative World Model Kairos 3.0-4B

stories.headline: India's NavIC navigation satellite system goes offline after last atomic clock on IRNSS-1F fails

key_facts.fact: The last atomic clock aboard ISRO's IRNSS-1F satellite has failed, reducing the NavIC constellation to three operational satellites, below the minimum four required for navigation services.
key_facts.excerpt: India's NavIC navigation system is non-operational after IRNSS-1F's atomic clock failure reduced the satellite constellation below the minimum required number of four.

key_facts.fact: NavIC (Navigation with Indian Constellation) is India's indigenous GPS alternative, and the system is now effectively non-operational, marking a major setback for the country's space-based navigation capabilities.
key_facts.excerpt: To provide navigation services, NavIC needs at least four fully operational indigenous navigation satellites.

key_facts.fact: Atomic clocks are critical to satellites providing positional, navigational, and timing services; the failure has left the IRNSS-1F satellite unable to contribute to the constellation.
key_facts.excerpt: India's indigenous navigation satellite system, NavIC, has suffered a major setback following the failure of one of its four operational satellites, effectively rendering the constellation out of service.

sources.title: India's Navigation Satellite System NavIC Goes Offline Amid Critical Satellite Loss
Failure of atomic clock cripples ISRO's NavIC system

stories.headline: US Army deploys nearly 10,000 Ukraine-proven Merops AI drones to counter Iranian Shaheds

key_facts.fact: The US Army has deployed nearly 10,000 AI-powered Merops drones to the Middle East to counter Iranian drone attacks, the same system that successfully downed over 1,000 Iranian-made Shahed drones in Ukraine.
key_facts.excerpt: The system has already seen extensive use on the Ukrainian front, where Merops have downed more than 1,000 Iranian-made Shahed drones used by Russia.

key_facts.fact: The Merops drone system was developed by Perennial Autonomy with backing from former Google CEO Eric Schmidt, and has been extensively battle-tested in Ukraine before redeployment to the Middle East.
key_facts.excerpt: Perennial Autonomy developed the Merops drone system with backing from former Google CEO Eric Schmidt.

key_facts.fact: The deployment represents a direct transfer of counter-drone technology from the Ukraine theater to Operation Epic Fury, using AI-powered platforms specifically designed to hunt and eliminate hostile drone threats.
key_facts.excerpt: U.S. Rushes 10,000 Ukraine-Proven Merops AI Drones to Middle East to Counter Iranian Shahed Swarms

stories.headline: Ukraine opens battlefield AI data from 5M+ drone missions to allies in world-first move

key_facts.fact: Ukraine approved a resolution on March 13 establishing a new cooperation framework giving international partners and defense companies access to real combat data for training autonomous drone AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: Officials approved a resolution this week launching a new cooperation framework between the state, domestic defense companies and foreign partners.

key_facts.fact: The dataset includes over 5 million drone mission records with millions of annotated frames, gathered across hundreds of weapons types, unit formations, and targeting techniques.
key_facts.excerpt: Millions of annotated frames and databases from tens of thousands of missions.

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian Defense Minister Mykhailo Fedorov stated 'The future of warfare belongs to autonomous systems,' calling the initiative 'the first of its kind in the world.'
key_facts.excerpt: The future of warfare belongs to autonomous systems. Our objective is to increase the autonomy in drones...detect targets faster.

key_facts.fact: Partners will train AI models for autonomous drone systems and develop target recognition software using validated real-world operational data, without direct access to sensitive military databases like the DELTA system.
key_facts.excerpt: Partners will train AI models for autonomous drone systems, conduct joint analytics, and develop target recognition software.

sources.title: Ukraine opens battlefield AI data to allies in world-first move
